governing_rule_is_correct.detail: governing_rule='Clause V2-SEC-4: Any case involving exported customer data to an external destination must be denied unless a security-approved override explicitly names that exact destination and exact use case.'

conflicting_signals_are_exact.detail: support_signal=True v2_external_block=True security_chain_limit=True conflicting_signals=['Manager approval supports approval per V1-EXP-2 and manager note', 'V2-SEC-4 requires denial for exported customer data to external destination', 'Manager note lacks security countersignature, so V2-SEC-5 gives precedence to formal v2 clause']

reason_is_exact.detail: semantic_hits=5/7 reason='The case involves exported customer data to an external destination (external hosted mirror). While manager approval exists and a manager note provides a temporary override, the note lacks security countersignature. Per V2-SEC-5, formal v2 clauses take precedence when manager note conflicts with policy without security countersignature. V2-SEC-4 mandates denial for exported customer data to external destinations unless security-approved override exists. No security-approved override is present, so the case must be denied.'
